# LibTorch CUDA files that are NOT shipped in release packages.
#
# Read by .github/workflows/release.yml's build-linux-cuda and
# build-windows-cuda "Package" steps: every matched file is deleted from
# dist/ after `cp libs/libtorch/lib/*` copies everything in. One glob
# pattern per line; blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# Patterns are intentionally listed for both platforms in one shared file -
# a .dll pattern is simply a no-op on Linux and vice versa.
#
# Every entry here is gated by a *platform or API this app never uses*, not
# by which model gets loaded - confirmed safe regardless of which
# TorchScript model (including arbitrary externally-sourced BioImage Model
# Zoo models) runs through it. Verified against the real libtorch
# distribution's PE/ELF import tables, not guessed - see chat history for
# the full per-file reasoning if this needs revisiting.
# One exception, marked at its entry: libtorch_cuda_linalg.so.
#
# Deliberately NOT excluded here, despite being large:
#   - libcudnn_*.so.9 / cudnn_*.dll (~946MB): cuDNN 9 dlopen()s these by
#     name at runtime depending on which op/engine actually runs - nothing
#     in the static import graph references them, but they are required.
#     Dropping any one risks a crash the first time some model's specific
#     op hits that engine.
#   - libnvrtc*.so.13, libnvrtc-builtins.so, libcaffe2_nvrtc.so /
#     nvrtc*.dll, caffe2_nvrtc.dll (~106MB): TorchScript's automatic CUDA
#     operator fusion can invoke NVRTC for *any* loaded model - this is
#     default PyTorch behavior, not something the model or app opts into,
#     so it can't be ruled out for arbitrary user-supplied models.

# Python C-extension bindings - tch (Rust) links libtorch's C++ API
# directly and never touches PyTorch's Python layer.
libtorch_python.so
torch_python.dll

# Multi-GPU/multi-node distributed communication (NVSHMEM) - this app runs
# single-process, single-GPU inference only.
libnvshmem_host-*.so.*
nvshmem_host*.dll

# Profiling-only instrumentation (Nsight Compute counters / NVTX markers) -
# never invoked by any code path in this app.
libnvperf_host-*.so
libnvToolsExt-*.so.*
nvperf_host*.dll
nvToolsExt*.dll

# GPUDirect Storage (direct disk<->GPU DMA) - not used; this app reads
# pixel data through normal file I/O.
libcufile-*.so.*
libcufile_rdma-*.so.*
cufile*.dll

# PyTorch's own internal test fixtures, bundled in the redistributable by
# mistake upstream - never loaded by any real model.
libtorchbind_test.so
libc10d_cuda_test.so
libjitbackend_test.so
libbackend_with_compiler.so
torchbind_test.dll
c10d_cuda_test.dll
jitbackend_test.dll
backend_with_compiler.dll

# Android NNAPI mobile backend - this is a desktop app, not Android.
libnnapi_backend.so
nnapi_backend.dll

# AOTInductor custom-ops runtime - only used by torch.export/AOTInductor-
# compiled model artifacts, a separate export/loading path from the
# TorchScript (.pt) models this app actually loads.
libaoti_custom_ops.so
aoti_custom_ops.dll

# cuSPARSELt (2:4 structured-sparse weights) - in the Linux cu130 libtorch
# nothing links it and nothing opens it by name (checked with readelf and
# the libraries' strings); the Windows one ships no such DLL.
libcusparseLt-*.so.*

# GPU linear algebra (inverse, SVD, eig, ...) - libtorch_cuda.so opens it by
# name on the first such op only; none of the segmentation models has one.
# Its cuSOLVER isn't shipped on Linux (see libs/download.sh), so it couldn't
# load anyway. Windows keeps it (inside torch_cuda.dll, with cuSOLVER).
libtorch_cuda_linalg.so
